## Context

- **HTTP/2** is usually negotiated by the **server** (TLS ALPN) and the reverse proxy; the application stack may see only the HTTP semantic layer. OxyRoute should define what it **guarantees** vs what depends on **Granian** / deployment.
- See [Feature gaps](https://github.com/QueryaHub/OxyRoute/blob/main/docs/feature.md#1-протокол-и-транспорт).

## Direction

- Document: running behind HTTP/2 (Granian + TLS), `httpx` HTTP/2 client smoke test, any caveats for RSGI.
- If something is **missing** in practice (e.g. trailers, pseudo-headers exposure), list gaps and whether Rust/Python changes are needed.

## Acceptance criteria

- Short section in `docs/` (or `rsgi.md`) + link from `docs/index.md`.
- Optional pytest marked `slow` or docs-only if CI cannot open TLS easily.

## Research

- Granian HTTP/2 support matrix; whether `scope` exposes HTTP version usefully.
